rca_of_the_issue: 1) /daily/submit JobPicker: minified 'b is not a function' fires immediately on option click in NewDailyReportV3 — most likely a callback prop passed to JobPicker is undefined or of wrong type (e.g., an object destructure/rename mismatch after refactor). /meetings/new uses the same JobPicker component successfully, so bug is in the parent handler wiring, not JobPicker itself. Fix: audit NewDailyReportV3.jsx JobPicker usage and ensure onSelect/onChange/onJobSelect prop matches the component's expected callback signature. 2) PDF: no admin-authenticated PDF route on backend or the existing route rejects session cookie auth. Fix: expose GET /api/daily-reports/{report_id}/pdf accepting admin session, generate PDF (e.g., WeasyPrint/ReportLab), return application/pdf; then wire admin DR detail 'PRINT / PDF' button to open that URL.
